Fake Science

FAKE: The fake science program offers BA and BS degrees and a minor.

Program Requirements

Students who major in fake science must complete the introductory sequence: FSCI 10100 and FSCI 10200.

The BS also requires FSCI 20100.

The minor requires FSCI 10100 & FSCI 10200.

Courses in the major must be taken for a quality grade.

FSCI 10100. Fake Science I. 100 Units.

An introduction to made-up science. Students may not receive credit for both FSCI 10100 and FSCI 10150.

Instructor(s): Staff    Terms Offered: Autumn Winter
Equivalent Course(s): FHIS 10100

FSCI 10150. Fake Science I, Accelerated. 100 Units.

A faster version of Fake Science I.

Terms Offered: Autumn
Prerequisite(s): Placement into FSCI 10150 or consent of instructor.

FSCI 10200. Fake Science II. 100 Units.

More made-up science.

Terms Offered: Winter Spring
Prerequisite(s): FSCI 10100 or FSCI 10150
Note(s): FAKE note.

FSCI 20100. Fake Methods. 100 Units.

Methods for the BS. This course replaces FSCI 19900.

Terms Offered: Spring Summer
Prerequisite(s): FSCI 10200 and third-year standing
